name: Four Seasons Hotel Mexico, D.F.
insider_take: Mexico City's most prestigious address sits in the heart of Polanco, where world-class luxury meets authentic Mexican culture in the bustling capital's most sophisticated neighborhood.
whats_special: This architectural gem occupies a prime corner in Polanco, Mexico City's Beverly Hills, just steps from the renowned Museo Nacional de Antropología. The hotel's rooftop offers stunning views of Chapultepec Park, one of the world's largest city parks, while being surrounded by high-end boutiques along Avenida Presidente Masaryk, Latin America's most expensive shopping street.
pro_tip: Request a park-view room on floors 8-10 for breathtaking sunrise views over Chapultepec Castle, the only royal castle in North America, without the tourist crowds below.
dont_miss: The hotel's proximity to Bosque de Chapultepec means you're minutes from six world-class museums, including the anthropology museum's famous Aztec Sun Stone. Take the hotel's luxury car service to nearby Roma Norte for the city's best cantinas and art galleries, then return for drinks at the hotel's sophisticated bar overlooking the urban canopy.
pros: Prime Polanco district location near luxury shopping and cultural attractions
Exceptional Four Seasons service standards and attention to detail
Elegant rooms and suites with modern Mexican design elements
Outstanding dining venues featuring local and international cuisine
